title: Open-local comparison of K-flat tensor homology
statement: Let X be a topological space and R a sheaf of commutative rings on its open site [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with underlying ring sheaf A, and U an open. Let P,Q be complexes of A-modules, P K-flat over R [def-pc-kflat-complex], and q:P→Q a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Let T,H be complexes of A restricted to the localized site U [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], T K-flat over R restricted to U, and s:H→Q restricted to U and t:H→T quasi-isomorphisms. For every sheaf F of A-modules and integer i, the restriction to U of H^i(Tot(P tensor_R F[0])) is isomorphic to H^i(Tot(T tensor_(R restricted to U) (F restricted to U)[0])) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. This statement has no degree bounds or scheme hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 0DJQ, local tensor calculation in its proof; Tag 08CI, (2) to (1); Tags 06YH and 06YB

proof.text: Apply open_localized_restriction_isKFlat to P. Apply localizedModule_restriction_quasiIso to q. Thus restricted P is K-flat and its map to restricted Q is a quasi-isomorphism.

In the standard Mathlib derived category of module sheaves on the localized site, compose the images of restricted q, the inverse image of s, and the image of t. DerivedCategory.right_fac extracts a common roof from L to restricted P and T. The left leg is a quasi-isomorphism by the fraction theorem; the right leg is one because its image is the composite of the left leg with an isomorphism and Q reflects quasi-isomorphisms. Resolve L using exists_isKFlatResolution and compose its augmentation with the two roof legs.

The private site_kFlat_tensor_quasiIso proves the tensor comparison for every ringed site. For a quasi-isomorphism a and K-flat K, use the acyclic-cone criterion and mapBifunctorMappingCone₁Iso to show a tensor id_K is a quasi-isomorphism. The bicomplex braiding followed by mapBifunctorFlipIso gives the other variable. Resolve the arbitrary second factor by a K-flat complex. The naturality square has three quasi-isomorphism sides, and quasiIso_of_comp_left gives the fourth. Apply this to both composites from the K-flat resolution of L.

Use open_localized_tensor_homology_iso for P and F. Take homology of the two tensor roof legs; they are isomorphisms by QuasiIso. Compose the open homology comparison with the inverse left-leg homology isomorphism and the right-leg homology isomorphism. This is the original unchanged conclusion.

theorem open_kFlat_tensor_homology_comparison
    {X : TopCat.{u}} (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) CommRingCat.{u})
    (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := R) P) (q : P ⟶ Q) (hq : QuasiIso q)
    (T H : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj (R.over U))) ℤ)
    (hT : IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := R.over U) T)
    (s : H ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) U).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q) (t : H ⟶ T) (hs : QuasiIso s) (ht : QuasiIso t)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) (i : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) U).obj
      ((mapBifunctor P ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj F)
        (@curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R))).homology i)) ≅
      ((mapBifunctor T ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) U).obj F))
        (@curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (R.over U)))).homology i))
